note: Johns Hopkins CSSE global COVID-19 time series (confirmed cases), January 2020 to March 2023.
title: Johns Hopkins CSSE COVID-19 confirmed cases (global)
description: Daily new confirmed cases for each country or province in the archived JHU CSSE global time series, computed as the difference of the cumulative counts. Corrections make some differences negative; those are sent as they are and the API rejects them (E-MEASURE-NEGATIVE), so the rejection log lists every correction.

sources.title: COVID-19 Data Repository, global confirmed time series
sources.publisher: Center for Systems Science and Engineering, Johns Hopkins University
sources.known_at_rule: Day of the value plus one day; the repository was updated daily (basis proxy_publication_lag).
